meanings.tr: tipi, kar körlüğü (görüşün sıfıra indiği yoğun kar/sis)
meanings.en: a weather condition in which snow and cloud make it impossible to see clearly
meanings.exampleEn: The climbers were trapped by a sudden whiteout near the summit.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağcılar zirveye yakın ani bir tipiye yakalandı.

meanings.tr: düzeltme sıvısı (yazıyı kapatmak için beyaz sıvı)
meanings.en: a white liquid used to cover mistakes in writing
meanings.exampleEn: She used whiteout to cover the typo on the form.
meanings.exampleTr: Formdaki yazım hatasını kapatmak için düzeltme sıvısı kullandı.

meanings.en: to make an object by cutting small pieces of wood off
meanings.exampleEn: He liked to whittle small figures out of pine.
meanings.exampleTr: Çam ağacından küçük figürler yontmayı severdi.

meanings.en: to gradually reduce the size or number of something
meanings.exampleEn: We whittled the list of candidates down to three.
meanings.exampleTr: Aday listesini üçe indirdik.

meanings.en: used to ask about the identity of a person
meanings.exampleEn: Who is going to help me carry these boxes?
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kutuları taşımama kim yardım edecek?

meanings.en: used to add information about a person already mentioned
meanings.exampleEn: The woman who called earlier left a message.
meanings.exampleTr: Daha önce arayan kadın bir mesaj bıraktı.

meanings.en: the person or people who; any person who
meanings.exampleEn: Whoever finishes first can leave early.
meanings.exampleTr: Kim önce bitirirse erken çıkabilir.

meanings.en: used instead of 'who' as the object of a verb or preposition
meanings.exampleEn: The candidate whom we interviewed was excellent.
meanings.exampleTr: Mülakat yaptığımız aday çok iyiydi.

meanings.en: used to ask who something belongs to
meanings.exampleEn: Whose jacket is this on the chair?
meanings.exampleTr: Sandalyedeki bu ceket kimin?

meanings.en: of whom or of which, used to add information
meanings.exampleEn: That's the author whose book won the prize.
meanings.exampleTr: İşte kitabı ödül kazanan yazar bu.

meanings.en: used to talk about what is going to happen in the future
meanings.exampleEn: I will call you when I get home.
meanings.exampleTr: Eve varınca seni arayacağım.

meanings.en: the mental power to control your thoughts and actions
meanings.exampleEn: She has a strong will and never gives up.
meanings.exampleTr: Güçlü bir iradesi var ve asla pes etmez.

meanings.en: a legal document stating who gets your property after you die
meanings.exampleEn: He left the house to his daughter in his will.
meanings.exampleTr: Vasiyetinde evi kızına bıraktı.

meanings.en: the ability to control your own thoughts and behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: It takes real willpower to quit smoking.
meanings.exampleTr: Sigarayı bırakmak gerçek bir irade gücü ister.

meanings.en: an amount of money that you get unexpectedly
meanings.exampleEn: They received a tax windfall after the new law passed.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasa çıkınca beklenmedik bir vergi kazancı elde ettiler.

meanings.en: successful in a competition or election
meanings.exampleEn: The winning team celebrated all night.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazanan takım bütün gece kutlama yaptı.

meanings.en: attractive in a way that makes people like you
meanings.exampleEn: She won them over with her winning smile.
meanings.exampleTr: Etkileyici gülümsemesiyle onları kendine hayran bıraktı.

meanings.en: the season of winter
meanings.exampleEn: In wintertime the lake often freezes over.
meanings.exampleTr: Kış mevsiminde göl sık sık donar.

meanings.en: desired or hoped for
meanings.exampleEn: The team finally achieved the wished-for result.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım nihayet umulan sonuca ulaştı.

meanings.en: in the company of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: I went to the cinema with my friends.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkadaşlarımla sinemaya gittim.

meanings.en: using something as a tool or means
meanings.exampleEn: She cut the bread with a sharp knife.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekmeği keskin bir bıçakla kesti.

meanings.en: in a way that is not easy; only with effort
meanings.exampleEn: He climbed the stairs with difficulty after the operation.
meanings.exampleTr: Ameliyattan sonra merdivenleri güçlükle çıktı.

meanings.en: quiet and preferring not to be with other people
meanings.exampleEn: After the loss he became quiet and withdrawn.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayıptan sonra sessiz ve içine kapanık biri oldu.

meanings.tr: geri çekilmiş, geri çekildi (withdraw fiilinin geçmiş ortacı)
meanings.en: past participle of withdraw; taken back or removed
meanings.exampleEn: The product was withdrawn from the market after complaints.
meanings.exampleTr: Ürün şikayetlerin ardından piyasadan çekildi.

meanings.en: before a period of time has passed
meanings.exampleEn: The order will arrive within three days.
meanings.exampleTr: Sipariş üç gün içinde ulaşacak.

meanings.en: inside the limits or range of something
meanings.exampleEn: Please stay within the marked area.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen işaretli alanın içinde kalın.

meanings.en: not having or using something
meanings.exampleEn: I can't read without my glasses.
meanings.exampleTr: Gözlüğüm olmadan okuyamıyorum.

meanings.en: to move unsteadily from side to side
meanings.exampleEn: The table wobbles because one leg is shorter.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir bacağı kısa olduğu için masa sallanıyor.

meanings.en: moving from side to side in an unsteady way
meanings.exampleEn: Be careful, that ladder is a bit wobbly.
meanings.exampleTr: Dikkat et, o merdiven biraz sallanıyor.

meanings.en: in exactly the same words; repeated exactly
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a word-for-word account of the conversation.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşmayı kelimesi kelimesine aktardı.

meanings.en: using too many words; in a long-winded way
meanings.exampleEn: He explained the rules wordily instead of getting to the point.
meanings.exampleTr: Sadede gelmek yerine kuralları lafı uzatarak anlattı.

meanings.en: a list of words, often for study or reference
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher gave us a wordlist to learn for the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen sınav için öğrenmemiz gereken bir kelime listesi verdi.

meanings.en: the time that is spent doing your job
meanings.exampleEn: Please don't make personal calls during work time.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen mesai saatlerinde özel arama yapmayın.

meanings.en: the social group made up mainly of people who do physical work for wages
meanings.exampleEn: He came from a working class family in the north.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuzeyde işçi sınıfı bir aileden geliyordu.

meanings.en: a day on which people go to work; the hours worked in a day
meanings.exampleEn: Your refund will be processed within five working days.
meanings.exampleTr: İadeniz beş iş günü içinde işleme alınacak.

meanings.en: the skill with which something is made
meanings.exampleEn: The furniture is expensive because of its fine workmanship.
meanings.exampleTr: Mobilya, ince işçiliği nedeniyle pahalı.

meanings.en: the state of having no value or usefulness
meanings.exampleEn: Depression can bring feelings of worthlessness.
meanings.exampleTr: Depresyon değersizlik hisleri getirebilir.

meanings.en: used to talk about a possible or imagined situation
meanings.exampleEn: I would travel more if I had the money.
meanings.exampleTr: Param olsa daha çok seyahat ederdim.

meanings.en: used to make a polite request or offer
meanings.exampleEn: Would you please open the window?
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen pencereyi açar mısınız?

meanings.en: hoping or trying to be a particular type of person
meanings.exampleEn: The workshop is aimed at would-be writers.
meanings.exampleTr: Atölye, yazar olmak isteyenlere yönelik.

meanings.en: covered in paper or other material
meanings.exampleEn: The gifts were beautifully wrapped in gold paper.
meanings.exampleTr: Hediyeler altın kağıda özenle sarılmıştı.

meanings.en: extreme anger
meanings.exampleEn: He feared the wrath of his father.
meanings.exampleTr: Babasının gazabından korkuyordu.

meanings.tr: bileklik, bilek bandı; küçük el çantası
meanings.en: a band, strap, or small bag worn around the wrist
meanings.exampleEn: She carried a small wristlet instead of a handbag.
meanings.exampleTr: El çantası yerine küçük bir bileklik çanta taşıdı.

meanings.en: a person who does something illegal or morally wrong
meanings.exampleEn: The law should punish the wrongdoer, not the victim.
meanings.exampleTr: Yasa mağduru değil, suçluyu cezalandırmalı.

meanings.en: not fair, morally right, or legal
meanings.exampleEn: He sued the company for wrongful dismissal.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketi haksız işten çıkarma nedeniyle dava etti.

meanings.en: the quality of being wrong, incorrect, or immoral
meanings.exampleEn: She sensed the wrongness of the decision immediately.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararın yanlışlığını hemen sezdi.

meanings.tr: harika çocuk, dâhi (genç yaşta çok başarılı kişi)
meanings.en: a person who is very successful at a young age
meanings.exampleEn: The tech wunderkind founded her first company at eighteen.
meanings.exampleTr: Teknoloji dâhisi ilk şirketini on sekiz yaşında kurdu.

meanings.en: a short, sharp cry, especially from a dog
meanings.exampleEn: The puppy gave a happy yip when it saw its owner.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek yavrusu sahibini görünce mutlu bir ciyaklama çıkardı.

meanings.en: the person or people being spoken to
meanings.exampleEn: Can you help me with this?
meanings.exampleTr: Bana bunda yardım edebilir misin?

meanings.en: the least old of a group of people or things
meanings.exampleEn: She is the youngest of five children.
meanings.exampleTr: Beş çocuğun en küçüğü o.

meanings.en: a young person or child
meanings.exampleEn: The club offers football training for youngsters.
meanings.exampleTr: Kulüp gençler için futbol antrenmanı sunuyor.

meanings.en: belonging to or connected with the person being spoken to
meanings.exampleEn: Is this your bag on the seat?
meanings.exampleTr: Koltuktaki bu çanta senin mi?

meanings.en: the thing or things belonging to the person being spoken to
meanings.exampleEn: My pen is broken; can I borrow yours?
meanings.exampleTr: Benim kalemim bozuk; seninkini ödünç alabilir miyim?

meanings.en: used to refer to the person being spoken to as the object
meanings.exampleEn: Be careful not to hurt yourself.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendine zarar vermemeye dikkat et.
